transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Well, what brings me in is... I just can’t keep my words in a straight line anymore. It's like I'll start talking about an overnight shift at work, and then I end up jumping to soccer, or paint colors, or patient charts. I just bounce around. And I can see everyone getting completely lost when I try to talk to them.
Have you recently needed much less sleep than usual without feeling tired the next day?

No, not really. I mean, I work those overnight shifts sometimes, so my schedule gets a little messed up, but... I definitely still need my sleep. If I don't get enough, I'm for sure tired the next day. I haven't had anything where I just stay awake and feel fine.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people do not?
No, I haven't noticed anything like that. I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. It's just my thoughts that get all jumbled up when I try to speak.
When did you first notice yourself jumping between topics like this when you speak?

I'd say it's been about a year and a month now. That's when the jumping around with my words really started. And... well, that's also around the same time I started getting this strong feeling that I was being watched. So yeah, both the jumbled talking and the feeling that people are watching me have been going on for about thirteen months.
How certain are you that people are watching you, and would you consider the possibility that this belief might be mistaken?

I'm completely sure about it. I know the supervisors changed my shifts on purpose so they can watch me through the unit cameras. They're trying to see if I'm unsafe on the floor. Other people tell me it's just because of staffing shortages, but... I know what's really going on. So no, I don't think I'm mistaken.
Since these problems began, have you had a significant decline in your ability to work or take care of your usual responsibilities?

Yeah, it really has. I mean, at work, I've needed my coworkers to double-check my rounds and my charting because I just can't keep it straight. And at home... I've fallen way behind on my bills. I've basically been ignoring my friends, and my apartment has just gotten completely out of control. It actually got bad enough that employee health sent me for an emergency evaluation... because I admitted to them that I was thinking about suicide.
